explanation: Pyruvate serves as a pivotal metabolite that determines the cell's metabolic direction. If oxygen (O2) is not available, anaerobic fermentation occurs in the cytoplasm, resulting in the incomplete metabolism of glucose to lactate or to carbon dioxide and alcohol (depending on the species). If oxygen is present, pyruvate is transported into the mitochondria to undergo aerobic cellular respiration.
